headline: Brazilian Mall Operator Multiplan Posts 73% Q3 Net Profit Growth
summary: Multiplan posted a 73.3% increase in third-quarter net profit to 383.2 million reais. Net revenue grew 37% to 846 million reais, while EBITDA climbed 37.3% to 598.2 million reais.
why: Multiplan is Brazil's premier commercial real estate and shopping mall developer, serving as a barometer for middle- and high-income domestic consumer spending.

impacts.name: Multiplan Empreendimentos Imobiliários S.A.
impacts.why: Robust double-digit revenue and EBITDA growth strengthen operating cash flows.
